brief.headline: Korean data-centre firm Elice plunges in Seoul market debut
brief.detail: Elice shares plunged 33% in their debut as AI worries sank the Korean IPO, adding to concern about AI valuations.

brief.detail: SpaceX boss Elon Musk said he will give one of his company's shares to every U.S. child next year, without explaining how it would work.

brief.headline: EQT agrees to acquire Cleanaway in A$9.3bn deal
brief.detail: Sweden's EQT agreed to acquire Australia's Cleanaway Waste Management in an A$9.3bn deal, with shares surging 20%, signalling active private equity dealmaking.

brief.headline: Silgan and American Industrial Partners to buy Trivium Packaging
brief.detail: Silgan and American Industrial Partners agreed to acquire Trivium Packaging in a $3.4 billion deal, a sizeable packaging transaction for dealmakers to watch.

brief.headline: Pump.fun shares rise after pre-IPO token launch for OpenAI, Polymarket
brief.detail: Pump.fun spiked 8% after a pre-IPO token launch tied to OpenAI and Polymarket, a story covered by 10 outlets and showing demand for pre-IPO exposure.
